name: Adelaïde
source: Adelaïde is a sla... servant from the Kingdom of France. She's been serving lady Gudrid since she was but a child and her only friends are Zaina and her. The poor girl can only speak French. Fortunately for her, both Gudrid and Zaina can speak French as well.
